s: Of converts to Judaism, a proselyte
710900.full: προσήλυτος, -ον (προοελαύνω), [in LXX for גֵּר ;] __1. one who has arrived, a stranger. __2. Of converts to Judaism, a proselyte (see DB, see word): Mat.23:15, Act.2:10 6:5 13:43.† (AS)

710903.full: 1. soft, gentle, kindly , (Pindar); προσηνές τι λέγειν (Thucydides) 2. with dative, λύχνῳ προσηνές, i. e. suitable for burning, (Herdotus Historicus) (For derivation, see. ἀπηνής). 3. adverb -νῶς, (Theophrastus Philosophus) (ML)

710905.full: 1. a putting to, application of ladders to a wall, (Thucydides); of the cupping-glass, (Aristotle Philosopher) 2. an adding, addition , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

710910.full: πρόσ-καιρος, -ον [in LXX: 4Ma.15:2 4Mac 15:8 4Mac 15:23 * ;] __1. in season. __2. for a season, temporary, transient: 2Co.4:18, Heb.11:25; of plants, short-lived: Mat.13:21, Mrk.4:17.† (AS)

710911.full: to set on fire or burn besides :—;Pass., σκεύη προσκεκαυμένα pots burnt at the fire , (Aristophanes Comicus): metaphorically, προσκαίεσθαί τινι to be in love with . . , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

710912.full: προσ-καλέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] to call to. Mid., to call to oneself (see M, Pr., 157): with accusative of person(s), Mat.10:1, Mrk.3:13 6:7, Luk.7:19, Act.5:40, Jas.5:14, al. Metaphorical, of the Divine call: Act.2:39; with inf., Act.16:10 (see Bl., § 69, 4); before εἰς, Act.13:2.† (AS)

s: to attend constantly, continue stedfastly, adhere to, wait on
710913.lxx: in LXX: Num.13:21 (חָזַק hith.), Tob.5:8 א, Da Th Su 1:6*
710913.full: προσ-καρτερέω, -ῶ (καρτερός, strong, stedfast) [in LXX: Num.13:21 (חָזַק hith.), Tob.5:8 א, Da Th Su 1:6* ;] to attend constantly, continue stedfastly, adhere to, wait on: with dative of person(s), Mrk.3:9, Act.8:13 10:7; with dative of thing(s), Act.1:14 2:42 6:4, Rom.12:12, Col.4:2; before ἐν, Act.2:46; εἰς, Rom.13:6.† (AS)

710914.full: 1. to leave besides as a legacy , ἀρχήν τινι (Thucydides) 2. to lose besides , τὰ αὑτῶν (Thucydides) (ML)

710916.full: 1. to be placed or laid by or upon, to lie by or upon , οὔατα προσέκειτο handles were upon it, (Iliad by Homer); τῇ θύρᾳ προσκεῖσθαι to keep close to the door, (Aristophanes Comicus); δοκοὶ τῷ τείχει προσκείμεναι lying near the wall, (Thucydides):—; ὁ προσκείμενος ἵππος the inside horse (turning a corner), (Sophocles Tragicus) 2. to lie beside, cling to , (Sophocles Tragicus): of a woman, to be given to wife , τινί (Herdotus Historicus) 3. generally, to be involved in or bound up with good or evil, with dative, (Sophocles Tragicus) 4. to be attached or devoted to , τινί (Herdotus Historicus), etc.; πρ. τῷ λεγομένῳ to put faith in a story, (Herdotus Historicus); πρ. οἴνῳ to be addicted to wine, (Herdotus Historicus); ἄγραις hunting, (Sophocles Tragicus), etc. 5. to press upon, be urgent with a person, with dative, (Herdotus Historicus); προσκείμενος with zeal , (Thucydides) 6. in military sense, to press close or hard, pursue closely , τινί (Thucydides); absolute to follow close , (Aristophanes Comicus); τὸ προσκείμενον the enemy , (Herdotus Historicus) 7. with a thing for the subject, to fall to, belong to , τοῖσι θεῶν τιμὴ αὕτη προσκέαται (Herdotus Historicus); πρ. τινι δοῦλος (Euripides):—; to be laid upon as a charge, to do something, with infinitive, (Herdotus Historicus) 8. to be added or attached to , (Sophocles Tragicus):—;absolute, ἡ χάρις προσκείσεται (Sophocles Tragicus) (ML)

710917.full: προσ-κεφάλαιον, -ου, τό [in LXX: Eze.13:18, 20 (כֶּסֶת), I Est.3:8 * ;] a pillow, cushion: Mrk.4:38.† (AS)

710918.full: painted scenery at the back of the stage

s: to make the scale incline one way or another
710920.full: προσ-κλίνω [in LXX: 2Ma.14:24 * ;] __1. to make to lean against. __2. to make the scale incline one way or another; hence, metaphorically, of persons, to incline (sc. ἑαυτόν) towards: pass., Act.5:36.† (AS)

s: reflexive, to stick to, cleave to
710921.full: προσ-κολλάω, -ῶ, [in LXX chiefly for דָּבַק ;] to glue to; pass., reflexive, to stick to, cleave to (Plat.): metaphorically (with dative, Jos.23:8, Sir.6:34 al.), before πρός, Mrk.10:7 (R, txt.), Eph.5:31 (LXX).† (AS)

710922.full: πρόσ-κομμα, -τος, τό (προσκόπτω), [in LXX: Exo.23:33 34:12 (מוֹקֵשׁ), Isa.8:14 (נֶגֶף), Jdth.8:22, Sir.17:25, al. ;] __(a) a stumble, stumbling: λίθος προσκόμματος (= נֶגֶף אֶבֶן, Isa, l.with), figuratively, Rom.9:32-33, 1Pe.2:8" (LXX) ; __(b) = προσκοπή, an occasion of stumbling, a stumbling-block: metaphorically, Rom.14:13, 20, 1Co.8:9 (Plut.).† SYN.: σκάνδαλον (cf. Cremer, 752 f.) (AS)

s: to take offence at, stumble at
710923.lxx: in LXX for נָגַף, כָּשַׁל ni., etc.
710923.full: προσ-κόπτω [in LXX for נָגַף, כָּשַׁל ni., etc. ;] __1. trans., to strike (e.g. hand or foot) against: with accusative before πρός, figuratively, Mat.4:6, Luk.4:11, (LXX) __2. Intrans., to stumble: absol. (Tob.11:9, Pro.3:23), Jhn.11:9-10; of wind, to rush against, beat upon: with dative, Mat.7:27. Metaphorical, in late writers, __(a) to offend (Polyb.); __(b) to take offence at, stumble at: before ἐν, Rom.14:21; with dative, τ. λόγῳ, 1Pe.2:8; τ. λίθῳ τ. προσκόμματος, Rom.9:32.† (AS)

s: to take offence at, be angry with
710924.full: 1. to strike against , τινί (Plato Philosophus):absolute to stumble, fail , (Plutarch) 2. to have a collision with another, give offence , (Demosthenes Orator); πρ. τινί (Plutarch) 3. to take offence at, be angry with , τινί (Demosthenes Orator), etc.: —;absolute to take offence , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

s: to make obeisance, do reverence to, worship
710925.lxx: in LXX chiefly for שָׁחָה hith.
710925.full: προσ-κυνέω, -ῶ (κυνέω, to kiss), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחָה hith. ;] to make obeisance, do reverence to, worship; __(a) prop. (as in cl., of the gods: Hdt., Æsch., Plat., al.), of God, Christ and supra-mundane beings: absol., Jhn.4:20 12:20, Act.8:27 24:11, Heb.11:21 (Westc., in l), Rev.11:1; πίπτειν καὶ π., Rev.5:14; with dative (of the significance of this constr. as com­pared with the usual cl., with accusative, see Abbott, JG, 78 f.; JV, 133 ff.), Jhn.4:21, 23, Act.7:43, 1Co.14:25, Heb.1:6, Rev.4:10 7:11 11:16 13:4, 15 14:7 16:2 19:4, 10 19:20 22:8-9; with accusative (see supr.), Mat.4:10, Luk.4:8 24:52 (WH, R, mg., om.), Jhn.4:22, 24, Rev.9:20 13:4, 8 13:12 14:9, 11 20:4; Seq. ἐπώπιον, Luk.4:7, Rev.15:4; __(b) as in cl., of homage to human superiors (cf. MM, xxi): absol., Mat.20:20, Act.10:25; with dative (see supr.), Mat.2:2, 8 8:2 9:18 14:33 15:25 18:26 28:9, Mrk.15:19, Jhn.9:38; πεσὼν., Mat.2:11 4:9; ἐνώπιον τ. ποδῶν, Rev.3:9; with accusative, Mrk.5:6 (dative T).† (AS)

710929.lxx: in LXX: Exo.4:16 AB2 (דָבַר pi.), Wis.13:17 *
710929.full: προσ-λαλέω, -ῶ [in LXX: Exo.4:16 AB2 (דָבַר pi.), Wis.13:17 * ;] to speak to: Act.28:20; with dative of person(s), Act.13:43.† (AS)

s: to take to oneself, take, receive
710930.lxx: in LXX: Psa.18:16 (מָשָׁה hi.), Psa.73:24 (לָקַח), etc.
710930.full: προσ-λαμβάνω [in LXX: Psa.18:16 (מָשָׁה hi.), Psa.73:24 (לָקַח), etc. ;] __1. to take in addition. __2. to take to oneself, take, receive; in NT always mid., -ομαι; __(a) of things: of food, with accusative, Act.27:33; with genitive part., Act.27:36; __(b) of persons: with accusative, Mat.16:22, Mrk.8:32 (see Swete, in l), Act.17:5 18:26 28:2, Rom.14:1, 3 15:7, Phm 17.† (AS)

710931.full: 1. Dep.: 2. to reckon or count in addition to , τί τινι (Herdotus Historicus) 3. to impute , τί τινι (Plutarch) (ML)

s: to wait longer, continue, remain still
to remain attached to, cleave unto, abide in
710934.lxx: in LXX: Jdg.3:25 A (חוּל hi.), Tob.2:2 א, Wis.3:9, 3Ma.7:17 *
710934.full: προσ-μένω [in LXX: Jdg.3:25 A (חוּל hi.), Tob.2:2 א, Wis.3:9, 3Ma.7:17 * ;] __1. to wait longer, continue, remain still: Act.18:18; before ἐν, 1Ti.1:3. __2. C. dative, to remain with: Mat.15:32, Mrk.8:32. Metaphorical, to remain attached to, cleave unto, abide in: τ. κυρίῳ, Act.11:23 (R, txt.; ἐν τ. κ., R, mg., see supr.); τ. χάριτι τ. θεοῦ, Act.13:43; τ. δεήσεσιν, 1Ti.5:5.† (AS)

710938.full: 1. a going or coming to, an approach , ἡ πρ. μάλιστα ταύτῃ ἐγένετο the approach was most feasible on this part, (Herdotus Historicus); ἀπείπατο τὴν πρ. rejected his advances , (Herdotus Historicus); πρ. μελάθρων approach to the halls, (Euripides) 2. an onset , πρόσοδοι τῆς μάχης onsets or attacks , (Euripides) 3. like πομπή II, a solemn procession to a temple with singing and music, (Aristophanes Comicus) 4. the coming forward of a speaker in a public assembly , γράφεσθαι πρόσοδον to petition for a hearing , (Demosthenes Orator); πρ. ποιεῖσθαι πρὸς τὸν δῆμον (Aeschines Orator) 5. income, rent , as opposite to principal, (Demosthenes Orator); often in plural, (Isaeus Orator) 6. of the public revenue, φόρων πρόσοδος (Herdotus Historicus); χρημάτων πρ. (Thucydides); mostly in plural the returns, revenue , Lat. reditus, (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)

710940.full: intransitive to smell of, be redolent of , with genitive, (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus) (ML)

710942.full: to call by a name , πρ. θεούς to give them the name θεοί, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

710943.full: to look at, behold , (Mimnermus Lyricus), etc.; compare aorist2 προσεῖδον:—;so in Mid., προσορωμένα (Sophocles Tragicus) (ML)

710945.lxx: in LXX: Lev.26:15, al. (גָּעַל); Lev.18:25, al. (קוֹא), Psa.95:10, Eze.36:31 (קוּט), Sir.6:25, al. (other writers use ὀχθέω, rarely -ίζω)
710945.full: προσ-οχθίζω [in LXX: Lev.26:15, al. (גָּעַל); Lev.18:25, al. (קוֹא), Psa.95:10, Eze.36:31 (קוּט), Sir.6:25, al. (other writers use ὀχθέω, rarely -ίζω) ;] to be angry with: with dative, Heb.3:10 (LXX), Heb.3:17.† (AS)

710948.full: 1. appearance, aspect, mien , (Pindar); periphrastic, σὴ πρ. thy presence , i. e. thyself , (Sophocles Tragicus) 2. a seeing, beholding, sight, view , (Euripides) (ML)

710949.full: 1. to play or sport with , τινί (Xenophon Historicus) 2. absolute to sport, jest , (Plato Philosophus) 3. with accusative, πρ. θεούς to sing to the gods, ὕμνον πρ. τὸν Ἔρωτα sang a hymn in praise of Eros, (Plato Philosophus) 4. to banter , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

s: to fall down at one's feet, fall prostrate before
710952.lxx: in LXX for נָפַל, נָגַע hi., כָּרַע
710952.full: προσ-πίπτω [in LXX for נָפַל, נָגַע hi., כָּרַע ;] __1. to fall upon, strike against: with dative, of wind, Mat.7:25. __2. to fall down at one's feet, fall prostrate before: absol., before πρός, Mrk.7:25; with dative of person(s), Mrk.3:11 5:33, Luk.8:28, Act.16:29; τ. γόνασιν, Luk.5:8.† (AS)

710954.lxx: in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc.
710954.full: προσ-πορεύομαι [in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;] to come near, approach: with dative of person(s), Mrk.10:35.† (AS)

710956.full: to sprinkle on one, τινί τι (Strabo Geographus) (ML)

710959.full: an ordinance, command , (Plato Philosophus), etc.; ἐκ προστάγματος (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

s: to give a command, enjoin, appoint
710962.lxx: in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi.
710962.full: προσ-τάσσω [in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;] __1. with accusative of person(s), to place at, to attach to. __2. to give a command, enjoin, appoint: Luk.5:14; with dative of person(s), Mat.1:24; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.8:4, Mrk.1:44; with accusative and inf., Act.10:48; pass., Act.10:33 17:26.† (AS)

s: one who stands before, a protector, guard, champion
a citizen who took care of the
710964.full: 1. one who stands before, a front-rank-man , (Xenophon Historicus) 2. a chief, leader of a party, (Herdotus Historicus); ὁ πρ. τοῦ δήμου (Thucydides) 3. generally, a president, ruler , (Aeschulus Tragicus), etc.; προστάται τῆς εἰρήνης its chief authors , (Xenophon Historicus) 4. one who stands before, a protector, guard, champion , πυλωμάτων (Aeschulus Tragicus), etc. 5. at Athens, of a citizen who took care of the μέτοικοι, as the Rom. patronus took care of his clientes; προστάτην γράφεσθαί τινα to choose as one's patron , (Aristophanes Comicus); but, γράφεσθαι προστάτου to enter oneself by one's patron's name , attach oneself to a patron , (Sophocles Tragicus) 6. προστάτης θεοῦ one who stands before a god to entreat him, a suppliant , (Sophocles Tragicus) (ML)

s: to add, join to, give in addition
710965.lxx: in LXX chiefly for יָסַף hi., also for אָסַף ni., etc.
710965.full: προσ-τίθημι [in LXX chiefly for יָסַף hi., also for אָסַף ni., etc. ;] __1. to put to. __2. to add, join to, give in addition: with accusative before ἐπί, Mat.6:27, Luk.3:20 12:25; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, Act.2:47; with accusative and dative, Luk.17:5, Heb.12:19 (see MM, xxi); pass., absol., Act.2:41, Gal.3:19; with dative, Mat.6:33, Mrk.4:24, Luk.12:31, Act.5:14 11:24; προσιτέθη πρὸς τ. πατέρας (cf. Gen.26:8, Jdg.2:10, al.), Act.13:36; with inf., of repeating or continuing the action signified by the following verb, as in Heb. idiom (Gen.4:2 8:12, al.; cf. WM, § 54, 5; Lft. on Clem., 1Co., xii; but see also M, Pr., 67, 233; Deiss., BS, 67.1; MM, xxi), Luk.20:11, Act.12:3; similarly ptcp., προσ-θείς, with indic. (Gen.38:5, al.), Luk.19:11.† (AS)

710967.full: προσ-τρέχω [in LXX for רוּץ ;] to run to: Mrk.9:15 10:17, Act.8:30.† (AS)

710972.lxx: in LXX: Num.6:3 (לַח), Deu.32:17, Ecc.1:9 (חָדָשׁ), Psa.81:9 (זוּר), Sir.9:10 *
710972.full: πρόσφατος, -ον (on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word and cf. -ως), [in LXX: Num.6:3 (לַח), Deu.32:17, Ecc.1:9 (חָדָשׁ), Psa.81:9 (זוּר), Sir.9:10 * ;] __1. originally, freshly slain. __2. Generally (from Æsch. on), new, fresh, recent: ὁδός, Heb.10:20 (see MM, Exp., xxi; Rutherford, NPhr., 471 f.).† (AS)

710973.full: προσφάτως adv. (see: πρόσφατος), [in LXX: Deu.24:5 (חָדָשׁ), Jdth.4:3, 5, Eze.11:3, 2Ma.14:36 2Mac 14:16 ;] recently: Act.18:2 (see MM, Exp., xxi).† (AS)

710974.lxx: in LXX chiefly for קָרַב hi.
710974.full: προσ-φέρω [in LXX chiefly for קָרַב hi. ;] __1. to bring to, lead to: with accusative and dative of person(s), Mat.4:24 8:16 9:2, 32 14:35 17:16, Mrk.2:4 (WH, R, txt.; sc. αὐτόν) Mrk.10:13, Luk.18:15 23:14; pass., Mat.12:22 (act., WH, txt.) Mat.18:24 (προσήχθη, WH) Mat.19:13; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.25:20; id. with dative of person(s), Mat.22:19, Luk.23:36; τ. στόματι, Jhn.19:29; metaphorically, with dative of person(s), to deal with, Heb.12:7 (cl.). __2. to offer: Mat.2:11, Act.8:18; esp. (as frequently in LXX; cf. FlJ, Ant., iii, 9, 3) sacrifices, gifts and prayers to God: absol., before περί (ὑπέρ), Mrk.1:44, Luk.5:14, Heb.5:1, 3 9:7 10:12; pass., Act.21:26; with accusative of thing(s) (δῶρον, θυσίαν, λυτρείαν, προσφοράν), Mat.5:23-24 (aoristic pres.; M, Pr., 247) Mat.8:4, Jhn.16:2, Act.7:42 21:26, Heb.5:1 8:3-4 9:7, 9 10:1-2, 8 10:11-12; δεήσεις τε κ. ἱκετηρίας, Heb.5:7; with accusative of person(s), Heb.11:17 (conative impf.; M, Pr., 129); of Christ, Heb.7:27 (ἀνενέγκας, WH, txt.) Heb.9:14, 25 9:28.† (AS)

710975.full: προσφιλής, -ές (φιλέω), [in LXX: Est.5:1, Sir.4:7 20:13 * ;] __(a) of persons, in both act, and pass. sense (LXX, ll. with); __(b) of things, pleas­ing, agreeable (EV, lovely): Php.4:8.† (AS)

710976.lxx: in LXX: 3Ki.7:48 (פָּנִים) Psa.40:6 (מִנְחָה), I Est.5:52, Sir.14:11, al.
710976.full: προσ-φορά, -ᾶς, ἡ (προσφέρω), [in LXX: 3Ki.7:48 (פָּנִים) Psa.40:6 (מִנְחָה), I Est.5:52, Sir.14:11, al. ;] __1. a bringing to, offering (Plat., al.). __2. (Less frequently in cl.), a present, an offering; in NT, of sacrificial offerings: Act.21:26 24:17, Eph.5:2, Heb.10:5, 8 10:14; περί ἀμαρτίας, Heb.10:18; with genitive obj., Rom.15:16, Heb.10:10.† (AS)

710977.full: 1. to make to grow to : metaphorically to make sure, confirm , (Aeschulus Tragicus) 2. Pass. or Mid., to grow to or upon , with dative, (Euripides):—;metaphorically to cling to , τῷ προσφὺς ἐχόμην (Odyssey by Homer); and absolute, προσφῦσα (Iliad by Homer); of a fish, τὠγκίστρῳ ποτεφύετο (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus) (ML)

710978.full: προσ-φωνέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 1Es.2:21 Est.6:6 Est.6:22, 2Ma.15:15 * ;] __1. to address, call to; in cl., with accusative of person(s), with dupl. accusative (cf. 2Mac, l.with); absol. (Hom., Od., v, 159, al.): Act.21:40 In late writers, with dative of person(s): Mat.11:16, Luk.7:32 13:12 23:20, Act.22:2. __2. to call by name, summon: with accusative (as in cl.), Luk.6:13.† (AS)

710982.full: a deposit made by water , πρ. Νείλου, of the Delta of the Nile, (Aeschulus Tragicus) from προσχώννυ_μι (ML)

s: go over to, come in, join
710983.full: 1. to go to, approach , with dative, (Herdotus Historicus); absolute, (Xenophon Historicus) 2. to come or go over to, come in, join , τινί or πρός τινα (Herdotus Historicus), attic; absolute, (Thucydides); also, πρ. ἐς ὁμολογίαν or ὁμολογίᾳ (Herdotus Historicus) 3. to accede to an opinion, (Herdotus Historicus); πρ. λόγοις τινός (Sophocles Tragicus): to make concessions , (Euripides) 4. to approach , i. e. to agree with, be like , τινί or πρός τινα (Herdotus Historicus) 5. to put faith in, believe , τινί (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

710986.lxx: in LXX chiefly and very frequently for פָּנִים
710986.full: πρόσωπον, -ου, τό (πρός, ὤψ), [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for פָּנִים ;] __1. prop., of persons (so always in cl.); __(a) the face, countenance: Mat.6:16-17, Mrk.14:65, Luk.9:29, 2Co.3:7, Rev.4:7, al.; τὸ π. τῆς γενέτεως (EV, natural face), Jas.1:23; πίπτειν ἐπὶ (τὰ) π., Mat.17:6, Luk.5:12, Rev.7:11, al.; ἀγνοούμενος τῷ π., Gal.1:22; π., οὐ καρδίᾳ, 1Th.2:17; κατὰ πρόσωπον (in front, facing: Thuc., Xen., al.), when present, face to face, Act.25:16, 2Co.10:1 10:7, Gal.2:11; id. with genitive, as compound prep., in the presence of (not cl.; see Bl., § 40, 9; M, Pr., 99 f.; Thackeray, Gr., 43 f.), Luk.2:31, Act.3:13; similarly ἀπὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים מִלִּפְּנֵי); see Dalman, Words, 29), from the presence of, Act.3:19 5:41 7:45, 2Th.1:9, Rev.12:14 20:11; πρὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים לִפְנֵי), before, Mat.11:10, Mrk.1:2, Luk.7:27" (LXX), al.; in other phrases resembling Heb. idiom (Thackeray, Gr., 42), βλέπειν (ὁρᾶν, θεωρεῖν, ἰδεῖν) τὸ π., to see one's face, i.e. see him in person, Mat.18:10, Act.20:25, 38, 1Th.3:10, Rev.22:4; ἐμφανισθῆναι τῷ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, Heb.9:24; ἐν π. Χριστοῦ, 2Co.2:10 4:6; μετὰ τοῦ π. σου with thy presence, Act.2:28 (LXX); εἰς π. τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν, 2Co.8:24; στηρίζειν τὸ π. (Heb. פָּנִים שׂוּם: Jer.21:10, al.; see Dalman, Words, 30), with inf., to set one's face towards, Luk.9:51; similarly, τὸ π. αὐτοῦ ἦν πορευόμενον (op. cit., 31), Luk.9:53; τὸ π. τοῦ κυρίου ἐπί, 1Pe.3:12 (LXX) __(b) form, person: καυχᾶσθαι. ἐν π. καὶ μὴ ἐν καρδίᾳ, 2Co.5:12 (cf. 1Ki.16:7); metaphorically, as in Heb. idiom, of judgment according to appearance, external condition or circumstances (פָּנִים H5387; see Dalman, Words, 30; Thackeray, Gr., 43 f.): λαμβάνειν π., Luk.20:21, Gal.2:6; βλέπειν εἰς π., Mat.22:16, Mrk.12:14; θαυμάζειν πρόσωπα, Ju 16. __2. Of things (cf. Dalman, l.with) __(a) face, appearance (Psa.104:30): Mat.16:3 (WH, R, mg., om.), Luk.12:56, Jas.1:11 __(b) surface (Gen.2:6): Luk.21:35, Act.17:26 (AS)

710987.full: προ-τάσσω [in LXX: 2Ma.8:36 R (Α, προστ-) * ;] __1. to place in front. __2. to arrange beforehand: Act.17:26, Rec. (for προστ., Edd.).† (AS)

710988.full: προ-τείνω, [in LXX: 2Ma_7:1-42, 3Ma_2:1 * ;] to stretch out, stretch forth: of preparations for scourging (see Field, Notes, 136 f.), Act.22:25.† (AS)

710992.full: A. Compar., πρότερος, -α, -ον, [in LXX for רִאשׁוֹן ,לִפָנִים, etc. ;] before, of time, place, rank, etc.; in NT always of Time, before, former: Eph.4:22. Adverbially, πρότερον, before, aforetime, formerly: Jhn.7:50, 2Co.1:15, Heb.4:6; opposite to ἔπειτα, Heb.7:27; τὸ π., Jhn.6:62 9:8, Gal.4:13, 1Ti.1:13; αἱ π. ἡμέραι, Heb.10:32; αἱ π. ἐπιθυμίαι, 1Pe.1:14.† (AS)

710997.full: προ-τρέχω [in LXX: 1Ki.8:11 (פָּנִים רוּץ), Job.41:13 (14) A (דּוּץ), Tob.11:3 (before ἔμπροσθεν), 1Ma.16:21 * ;] __1. to run forward. __2. to run on, run in advance: Jhn.20:4; before εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν, Luk.19:4.† (AS)
